children: The appointments strengthen the B2B platform’s Board with expertise across performance, talent, technology, strategy and governance as it scales nationwide

JSW One Platforms has appointed Olympian and business leader Aparna Popat Ved and former McKinsey & Company and Uber India executive Prabhjeet Singh as Independent Directors on its Board. The appointments come as the B2B digital platform looks to scale its technology, distribution and financial services capabilities across India.

The appointments broaden the Board’s expertise across technology, talent and governance as JSW One Platforms continues to build an integrated technology, commerce and financial services platform serving India’s manufacturing and construction ecosystem, with a focus on micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs).
Aparna Popat Ved is a two-time Olympian and three-time Commonwealth Games medallist. She received the Arjuna Award in 2005 and holds an MBA.

She currently serves as an Independent Director on the boards of Eternal Limited, formerly Zomato Limited, and Hero FinCorp Limited. She has also co-founded All Is Well of Meboki Technologies Private Limited and served as Executive Director of the Olympians Association of India.
Her appointment brings perspectives on performance culture, resilience, goal-driven execution and talent development to the JSW One Platforms Board.
Prabhjeet Singh brings experience in strategy and management across businesses in India, including previous associations with McKinsey & Company and Uber Systems India.

He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, and a postgraduate diploma in management from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad Society.
Singh has also received the Young Alumni Achiever award and the Kollengode V. Srinivas Award for the Best PGP Allrounder from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad.

Commenting on the appointments, Gaurav Sachdeva, Joint Managing Director & CEO, JSW One Platforms, said, “As JSW One enters its next phase of growth, it is important that our Board brings together the breadth of perspectives needed to build a technology-led, high-performance organisation at scale. Aparna’s experience in mentoring high-performance teams and her perspectives on resilience and goal-driven execution will add a valuable dimension to how we build talent and culture at JSW One.

Prabhjeet, who has previously been associated with McKinsey & Co. and Uber India, brings deep experience in scaling a technology platform in India. We are delighted to welcome Aparna and Prabhjeet to the JSW One Board.”
The appointments further strengthen the Board as JSW One Platforms expands its technology, commerce and financial services capabilities for India’s manufacturing and construction ecosystem.
